test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

She ______ to the market every morning.
solution:
The correct answer is '**goes**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**goes**" is the simple present tense form of the verb "**go**" used for third-person singular subjects.
 
• The sentence describes a habitual action ("**every morning**"), so the present tense "**goes**" is required.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and 4 are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"She **goes**__ to the market every morning."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "go"** is incorrect because it is not conjugated for third-person singular subjects.
 
• **Option 2: "gone"** is incorrect because it is the past participle form and does not fit here.
 
• **Option 4: "going"** is incorrect because it is the present participle form and does not fit here.
